task.title: How many widgets does the inventory hold?
task.description: In the repository ${repo}, find how many widgets the inventory holds. Report the number and where it comes from.

path.comment: Agent tariboy-dev-bob asked on this task: "Should I count the widget kinds or the total number of units?" My answer: count the total number of units, the sum of `count` over all widgets. Bob is busy now; another agent takes the task.
